name: description
Seed Archive: A case 3 cells wide and 4 tall with three independently renameable 10×15 pages for a total of 450 cells. Stores seeds and seed containers as well as hydroponic nutrient tablets and their containers. A Seed Archive cannot go inside another Seed Archive. Fits in general-purpose containers with enough room. Routine inspections do not seize illegal seeds stored inside. If you own no Seed Archive you can buy one from Jackson at night or from Jackson or the retired farmer when they visit. Drop metal ingots onto the case. At 5 total it changes to 3×3. At 10 total it changes to 2×2. Hover to check progress.

name: description_compact
Seed Archive: Legacy 2×2 case. It expands to 3×4 when there is room. Three tabs with 450 cells.

name: footprint_notice
Seed Archive: New Seed Archives occupy 3×4 cells. Drop metal ingots onto the case to refit it. A total of 5 changes it to 3×3. A total of 10 changes it to 2×2. You can pay in batches. Cases already refitted to 2×2 keep their size. Your tabs and stored items stay in place.

name: overflow_notice
Seed Archive: The Seed Archive was placed in extra counter space because the store inventories were full.

name: description_legacy_square
Seed Archive: Legacy 3×3 case. It expands to 3×4 when there is room. Three tabs with 450 cells.

name: description_refitted
Seed Archive: Compact case occupying 2×2 cells. Three tabs with 450 cells for seeds and seed containers as well as hydroponic nutrient tablets and their boxes.

name: description_refitted_square
Seed Archive: Square refit occupying 3×3 cells. Three tabs with 450 cells. At 10 total metal ingots it can be refitted to 2×2.

name: description_square_pending
Seed Archive: Occupying 2×2 until there is space for the paid 3×3 refit. Three tabs with 450 cells.
